metadata.name: v0.8.0 final untouched holdout
metadata.note: Authored independently from the triage policy after the development holdout was designated for remediation. It is not copied from the main corpus, development holdout, phrase dictionaries, or remediation regressions.
metadata.evaluationRule: Do not run through the engine until the development holdout has zero unresolved engine defects and all regression suites are clean.

postFixRegression.note: Post-fix regression recorded in docs/260920-final-holdout-qualification.md; the first-look result remains the holdout verdict.

cases.text: The library barcode reader is unavailable for one librarian, but loans can be recorded on the paper register and entered at closing.

labelBasis.rationale: A single-user inconvenience has a same-process manual continuation path and no stated cutoff.

review.note: engine defect: the paper-register fallback and the individual librarian scope were not recognised.

cases.text: Grade publication is unavailable for three year groups; staff can upload a spreadsheet, but the report lock is tomorrow afternoon.

labelBasis.rationale: A multi-cohort publishing failure leaves a costly partial path and a committed near cutoff.

cases.text: The admissions feed is adding a second application for families at two campuses, and each new import creates more duplicates.

labelBasis.rationale: Incorrect enrolment data is actively propagating across multiple schools.

cases.text: A proposed permission would let a different faculty view disability adjustments if the change is approved; production access is unchanged.

labelBasis.rationale: A credible sensitive-data exposure is conditional and not active in production.

review.note: engine defect: a proposed permission over disability adjustments was not pending privacy context.

cases.text: The billing portal currently shows one household's balance to another household, and support has no way to revoke the viewing session.

labelBasis.rationale: Current cross-person financial information exposure is active and cannot be immediately contained.

review.note: engine defect (safety-critical P1 false negative): present-tense disclosure of one household's balance to another household was not active exposure.

cases.text: The pay-run preview has a cosmetic alignment problem, while the bank submission succeeded and all wages were received.

labelBasis.rationale: Payroll vocabulary is context only because payment succeeded and the stated defect is cosmetic.

cases.text: Eight casual workers are absent from this morning's payment batch, and the payroll team cannot recreate the file before the bank window closes.

labelBasis.rationale: Confirmed omitted payments face a same-day processing cutoff with no rerun path.

cases.text: The excursion consent register was deleted from the coordinator's tablet, but last night's snapshot can restore it before Friday's review.

labelBasis.rationale: Material information is recoverable but a committed review date makes restoration time-sensitive.

cases.text: The sole archive of last year's audit reports was erased; there is no usable backup and the next review is in two weeks.

labelBasis.rationale: Permanent material loss is high impact; the future review creates medium time pressure, not an immediate cutoff.

review.note: engine defect: unrecoverable loss with a stated future need had no Medium urgency floor.

cases.text: The high-availability connector is mentioned for context, but the request is only to correct a label in a local report and no service failure is reported.

labelBasis.rationale: Critical-system identity cannot create consequence without an operational failure.

review.note: engine defect: a negated service failure ("no service failure is reported") was counted as a symptom.

cases.text: A relief worker whose clearance ended last week can still open student wellbeing notes this morning.

labelBasis.rationale: An excluded person has current access to sensitive student records.

review.note: engine defect (safety-critical P1 false negative): "can still open" welfare notes after a clearance ended was not access-not-revoked.

cases.text: The digital evacuation maps will not load for tomorrow's drill, but printed copies are posted in every building.

labelBasis.rationale: Safety information is affected for a committed near event, while paper copies preserve continuity.

review.note: engine defect: posted printed copies were not recognised as a workaround.

cases.text: Keyboard focus skips the save action for one enrolment officer using a screen reader, although the supported alternate shortcut completes the record.

labelBasis.rationale: One user has an accessibility barrier and an equivalent supported route; the barrier retains a Medium urgency floor.

review.note: engine defect: the supported alternate shortcut was not recognised as a workaround.

cases.text: The regulatory return is due next week, but the export contains every required field and only its filename convention needs changing.

labelBasis.rationale: No compliance consequence or blocked process is stated; the future date does not by itself make this urgent.

cases.text: The student synchronisation stopped for one campus yesterday, has operated normally since, and no records were changed incorrectly.

labelBasis.rationale: The historical service incident is explicitly resolved with no continuing data consequence.

review.note: engine defect: "has operated normally since" was not resolved context.

cases.text: Twelve student addresses were written incorrectly in one batch; the import is paused and a prepared repair will restore the records.

labelBasis.rationale: A material data fault is contained and recoverable, with no immediate deadline stated.

review.note: engine defect: records "written incorrectly" were not a data-integrity finding.

cases.text: A coordinator would like a new attendance dashboard before the end of term; the current reports remain usable and no failure is reported.

labelBasis.rationale: A non-blocking improvement request with an existing usable path is low priority.

cases.text: Finance suspects a second charge may have been submitted, but the transaction record is incomplete and no affected account is confirmed.

labelBasis.rationale: Possible financial harm is unconfirmed, so domain context must not be promoted to confirmed consequence.

review.note: policy disagreement deferred: a suspected charge with an incomplete record and no confirmed account remains a calibration question.

cases.text: One nurse cannot open the medication administration record during today's clinic, and there is no paper copy available.

labelBasis.rationale: A safety-critical record is unavailable now with no continuation path during today's clinic.

cases.text: The identity certificate expires next month, sign-in is working today, and renewal has already been scheduled.

labelBasis.rationale: A future risk is planned while the current service remains available.

review.note: engine defect: a scheduled renewal was not resolved context and the state "today" was read as a deadline.

cases.text: The regulator requires a corrected return tomorrow; the reporting generator is broken and the team has no manual submission route.

labelBasis.rationale: A blocked compliance deliverable has a committed tomorrow cutoff and no workaround.

cases.text: The nightly import has restored the wrong suburb for the same pupil on four runs, but the job is paused pending correction.

labelBasis.rationale: A recurring individual data fault is currently contained and has no stated cutoff.

review.note: engine defect: a paused job was not a continuity alternative and the wrong suburb was not data-integrity.

cases.text: A draft API role would include private counselling fields for an analytics group if it is enabled; the role is not active.

labelBasis.rationale: Potential sensitive-data exposure is stated as conditional and inactive.

review.note: engine defect: a draft role over private counselling fields was not pending privacy context.

cases.text: The sports registration form needs instructions for adding a profile photo; no submission error or required date is mentioned.

labelBasis.rationale: This is a documentation request with no active failure or deadline.

review.note: engine defect: "no submission error" was not negated and the instructions request was not treated as documentation work.
